[[File:BotiqAd-HoloNetNewsVol531-45.png|thumb|300px|Botiq advertisement]]
'''Botiq''' was an entity advertised on the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]]<ref name="Botiq Ad">{{HoloNetNewsAd|url=meta/img/ads/98_1.gif|text=BOTIQ}}</ref> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Date">The advert can appear on any of the [[HoloNet News (original website)|Holonet News]] articles that range from {{HoloNetNewsWeb|45||HoloNet News Vol. 531 #45}} to {{HoloNetNewsWeb|56||HoloNet News Vol. 531 #56}}. These articles date themselves to 13:2:28 [[Great ReSynchronization|G.R.S.]] and 13.5.15 G.R.S respectively, corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] according to the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> The advertisement consisted of a [[Color/Legends|blue]]-tinted box that framed a pair of [[Clothing/Legends|shoes]]. The name "Botiq," written in the [[High Galactic/Legends|High Galactic alphabet]] and colored white with a black shadow, lay in the foreground.<ref name="Botiq Ad" />

==Behind the scenes==
Botiq was mentioned in an advertisement<ref name="Botiq Ad" /> on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|''HoloNet News'' website]]<ref name="HoloNet News">[[HoloNet News (original website)|''HoloNet News'' website]].</ref> written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]].<ref name="HNN Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref> [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 45|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #45]], the first set of articles,<ref name="HNN45">{{Hnn|45||HoloNet News Vol. 531 #45}}</ref> was published to the ''HoloNet News'' website on [[February 28]], [[2002]].<ref name="HNN45 date">Per {{JCFCite|url=posts/6042498|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=IAmTheDarkSide|date=2002-03-14|time=5:40 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220914072556/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-4#post-6042498}}, [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 47|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #47]] was released on [[March 14]], [[2002]]. As [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News]] segments were published weekly, and {{Hnn|45||A Closer Look}} was published two issues prior, it must have been released on [[February 28]] of the same year.</ref>
